author: Assistant session at the owner's request, after an independent review subagent; owner acceptance pending through the review of PR #24
reason: Independent review of the uncommitted M10 tooling (no blocking defect; gate A-G recomputed PASS by the reviewer) found five non-blocking weaknesses of tools/report_increment10.py, fixed here:

(1) produced_sha256 of the run records was never checked: G now binds every produced file directly or through sanitization-post-write.json (original == recorded, sanitized == current). The map covers 13 files (not the two O7 records stated in amendment 004 reason 3, which predates the second sanitization); sanitization-reversal-local.json shows, on the owner machine, that putting the absolute paths back reproduces all 13 original digests.

(2) Evidence.latest() allowed repeat-until-pass: attempts are ordered numerically and G requires every superseded attempt with a run record to be named by an amendment (only F-sync attempt 1, amendment 004); blocked attempts were never started.

(3) F: the 14B oracle captures are bound to the O14 run records; the 7B end-to-end equivalence is recomputed from the capture files, the oracle10 side bound to the O7 run record and the oracle9 side to results/increment9/capture-manifest.json.
(4) G checks guest swap growth also at the end of each run (scope global_after against the campaign baseline).
(5) C recomputes the sustained-paging rule (PagesInput > 2048/s for >= 30 s) from the kept monitor samples, in addition to the annotations.
The previous final suite and gate outputs are kept (campaign/pytest-final-a2.*, campaign/gate10-a1.json).

not_verifiable_on_runner.skip_message: local unsanitized originals are not on this machine
not_verifiable_on_runner.cause: tests/test_increment9_hardening.py "-real" cases need the local unsanitized M9 originals, which are deliberately not in Git (sanitization of increment 9)

ci_runner_verification.rule: runner verdict PASS = every runner-verifiable required test passed, nothing missing, extra or duplicated, and each declared test either passed or was skipped with exactly the declared message; such a skip is NOT VERIFIABLE ON RUNNER and keeps the full-inventory verdict of the runner at NOT PROVEN. The archived local attestation must be a full PASS of the same inventory with its pinned JUnit SHA256. CI succeeds only if both hold.
